page.layout: One column of text on a single printed page. Running head at the top. Numbered questions in italic, hanging indent. Signature mark at the foot.

main_text.p: 13. An ne bona per laicos in personas ecclesiasticas transferantur?
14. An ne Pontificius ordini alicui adscriptus, res immobiles extra familiam alienet?
15. An illicitum statutum, quo conventicula, pro secta cujusdam exercitio, vetantur?
16. An ut sectarii ab officiis vel honoribus arceantur?
17. An ut naufragorum bona fisco applicentur?
18. An ut in causa homicidii non nisi multa pecuniaria exigatur?
19. Quid judicandum de statuto, quod exigit, ut simplex furtum capite puniatur?
20. An statuto introduci possit, ut pater de delicto filii teneatur, usque ad legitimam?
21. An ut fidejussor admittatur in causis criminalibus?

page.notes: Scan is a Google digitisation; the "Digitized by Google" watermark at lower right is not transcribed. The printed signature "H 5" is at the foot centre; a stamp-like mark "I. D." at lower right is uncertain and omitted. Some italic long-s forms were rendered as plain s. Printed words with doubtful letters: "Pontificius" and "fidejussor" read as printed.
